title: Claude Haiku 5.5: Migrate Without Breaking Requests - AI Daily Diff Oct 9
closing_line: Audit request compatibility, then compare effort levels on your own labeled tasks before production rollout.

items.headline: Audit request compatibility before moving a scoped workload to Claude Haiku 5.5.
items.what_changed: The October 7 release adds adjustable effort and new migration requirements for Messages API clients.
items.why_it_matters: A model-ID swap alone can leave incompatible parameters, truncated replies or unhandled refusal states.
items.who_should_care: Builders running high-volume classification, extraction, summarization or subagent tasks on Haiku.

diff.minus: Haiku 4.5 integrations may use manual thinking budgets, sampling parameters or assistant prefills.
diff.plus: Haiku 5.5 uses adaptive thinking, an effort control and a revised request contract.

items.watch_out: Recount tokens and leave room for thinking. We did not test model quality, latency or cost live.

walkthrough.use_case: Proposed migration audit for an existing Haiku 4.5 ticket classifier or document summarizer with a labeled evaluation set.
walkthrough.steps:
Inventory the current model ID, thinking configuration, sampling parameters, assistant prefills and response parsing.
Replace the platform-specific model ID with claude-haiku-5-5.
Use adaptive thinking and remove unsupported temperature, top_p and top_k parameters.
Select response blocks by type, allow for thinking within max_tokens, and handle stop_reason refusal.
Recount prompts with the new model and compare two or three effort levels on the same labeled task set before rollout.
walkthrough.availability: Available now on Claude Platform, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure; platform-specific model IDs and service limits apply.
walkthrough.limitations: Documented migration plan only. No live Claude API call, independent benchmark, latency measurement or production reliability test.
walkthrough.evidence_label: Official launch and migration documentation reviewed; no live model test.

youtube_description:
Claude Haiku 5.5 was released on October 7 with adjustable effort and a revised Messages API migration contract. This builder briefing shows what to audit before replacing a Haiku 4.5 model ID and how to plan a task-specific evaluation.

- Replace the model ID with the correct platform-specific Haiku 5.5 identifier.
- Move manual thinking budgets to adaptive thinking and calibrate the effort parameter.
- Remove unsupported sampling parameters and assistant prefills.
- Parse content blocks by type, recount tokens, leave room for thinking, and handle refusal stop reasons.
- Compare effort levels on the same labeled classification or summarization set before rollout.

This is a documented migration walkthrough, not a live Claude API test or an independent quality, latency or cost benchmark. Follow AI Daily Diff for verified model capabilities and practical implementation decisions.
